metadata.description: Free LGO REI tools for Claude. First up: the RV Park Quick Underwrite bird-dog deal screen.

plugins.name: lgo-rv-underwrite
plugins.description: RV Park Quick Underwrite — first-pass deal screen for RV parks, MHPs, and campgrounds. Interviews for ~10 inputs, runs the LGO math (implied cap, 9%-cap reprice, offer matrix, seller-finance vs SBA DSCR/CoC), scores the LGO Decision Matrix, and outputs a one-page Deal Snapshot with a go/no-go verdict. Now includes the LGO 8-step process and deep-underwrite playbook.
